

// ============================================================
// 第1部分：天线方向图定义  除了peak_gain，其余固定写死
// ============================================================

// ========== 微波链路（X/Ku） ==========
//普通集群任务无人机机载宽波束
antenna_pattern MICRO_UAV_OMNI_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
        peak_gain 3 dB     //界面配置项
        azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
        elevation_beamwidth 65 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

//后方公共服务平台地面车载微波定向
antenna_pattern MICRO_REAR_PLATFORM_DIR_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
        peak_gain 18 dB   //界面配置项
        azimuth_beamwidth 12 deg
        elevation_beamwidth 12 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.2 高增益全向天线（干扰站专用，8dB增益）
antenna_pattern OMNI_ANTENNA_HIGHGAIN
    uniform_pattern
        peak_gain 8 dB   //界面配置项
        azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
        elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.3 C波段定向天线（指挥车专用，25dB增益，俯仰-3°~+85°）
antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB     //界面配置项
      azimuth_beamwidth 15 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 88 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.3 C波段定向天线（无人机专用，25dB增益，俯仰-3°~+85°）
antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB     //界面配置项
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 88 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// L波段新一代数传 (集群指挥车专用，定向跟踪天线)
// 说明：方位360°×n连续、俯仰‑3°~+85°为伺服转台机械运动范围；天线电磁波为窄波束；仿真假定伺服始终对准目标
antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 14 dB     //界面配置项
      azimuth_beamwidth 20 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 88 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// L波段新一代数传 无人集群无人机机载全向天线
// 适配中小型无人机机动翻滚，无需伺服跟踪，水平360°全域覆盖
antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 4 dB    //界面配置项
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 70 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 地面车载卫星通信动中通天线（后方公共服务平台）
// 25dBi；方位360°、俯仰大角度为伺服转台机械运动范围；电磁波为窄波束；仿真假定伺服对准卫星
antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB    //界面配置项
      azimuth_beamwidth 4 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 4 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 卫星星载对地通信点波束天线(卫星专用)
antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 30 dB     //界面配置项
      azimuth_beamwidth 45 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 45 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 普通无人集群任务无人机 轻量化机载卫星通信宽波束天线
// 中小型集群无人机载荷受限，宽波束电扫覆盖卫星视域，无机械伺服(无人机专用)
antenna_pattern SAT_UAV_CLUSTER_WIDEBAND_ANTENNA
  uniform_pattern
    peak_gain 30 dB     //界面配置项
    azimuth_beamwidth 110 deg
    elevation_beamwidth 100 deg
  end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.5 激光通信天线（窄波束，40dB增益，5°×5°）
antenna_pattern LASER_COMM_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 40 dB   //界面配置项
      azimuth_beamwidth 5 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 5 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// ============================================================
// 第2部分：雷达散射截面积定义(固定写死)
// ============================================================

radar_signature DRONE_SIG
  constant 1.0 m^2
end_radar_signature

radar_signature COMMAND_VEHICLE_SIG
  constant 5.0 m^2
end_radar_signature

radar_signature SAT_SIG
  constant 3.0 m^2
end_radar_signature


// ============================================================
// 第3部分：网络拓扑定义
// ============================================================

network COM_MESH_NET WSF_COMM_NETWORK_MESH
end_network

network FIBER_NET WSF_COMM_NETWORK_P2P
end_network

medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM WSF_COMM_MEDIUM_UNGUIDED
    channels 4
    default_mode_name "default"
    mode "default"
      propagation_speed constant 299792458 m/sec
      transfer_rate constant 4000000 bit/s
      packet_loss_time constant 0 sec
    end_mode
end_medium

// 光缆介质定义
medium FIBER_MEDIUM WSF_COMM_MEDIUM_GUIDED
    channels 4
    default_mode_name "default"
    mode "default"
        propagation_speed constant 200000000 m/sec   
        transfer_rate constant 1000000 bit/s 
        packet_loss_time constant 0 sec
    end_mode
end_medium
